decision: Carry recalledIds (ULIDs) in the recall emit meta and add a recall.utilization emit at outcome-time; correlate by runId+step at read-time
alternatives: ride signal.satisfaction meta instead of a new kind; call muninn_feedback per-id
reasoning: context.md D2/D3 lock a new recall.utilization kind on the open union, no feedback, no schema bump; recalledIds must be threaded at recall-time so the read-time join has the left side
risk: correlation is post-hoc/statistical (run-level outcome to per-memory), not a per-memory score write-back

decision: Add a new sibling test in luca-tools asserting all 5 .ts mode artifacts carry a RUNNABLE record-recall command (full luca telemetry emit incl --run-id and the 6 recordRecallAction meta keys), rather than extending the luca-mastracode .md-only recall-prose.test.ts
alternatives: extend recall-prose.test.ts to also read the .ts artifacts
reasoning: recall-prose.test.ts lives in luca-mastracode and reads .md instructions; the .ts artifacts are a different package/surface, so a colocated luca-tools test is the right home and avoids cross-package coupling
risk: test must assert runnability (command shape + meta keys), not token presence, to avoid the phantom-capability pitfall
